privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: This policy explains what information Beer Agency collects through beer.krd and how we use it.

When you send the contact form we collect your name, phone number, optional email address, the service you're interested in, your budget range and your message. We use this only to reply to you and to discuss your project.
Your information is stored on our own server and is only accessible to Beer Agency staff. We never sell or share it with third parties for advertising.
We use privacy-friendly analytics that do not use cookies or track you across websites.
To see, correct or delete the information we hold about you, contact us using the details on our contact page.
